title: B&G Ecocirc: E02 high motor current
equipment: B&G Ecocirc circulator (field-derived draft; E02 meaning is field-reported)

n1.text: Record the complete model, fault and operating condition. Has the pump been power-cycled and has E02 returned?

r_first.cause: A single E02 may be a one-off event, but the cause is not yet known.
fix: Record the code, time and whether it appeared at startup or after running, before resetting.
Clear it only as the manual instructs and watch startup and normal operation.
A successful restart does not prove the underlying issue is resolved.

n2.text: After safe shutdown and lockout/tagout per the manufacturer, is there visible or mechanical trouble: binding, obstruction, abnormal noise or damage?

r_mech.cause: Mechanical binding or obstruction is a likely cause of high motor current.
fix: Correct it only as the service manual allows, then retest.
Do not repeatedly power-cycle a persistent fault.

r_supply.cause: No mechanical cause found; supply, wiring or motor condition remain possible.
fix: Have a qualified person check supply voltage and wiring against the nameplate and manufacturer limits.
Do not assume the motor is the only cause.
If the fault persists, follow the exact model manual for service and replacement criteria and escalate rather than guess at an internal failure.
After correction, confirm the pump completes startup and runs under normal conditions without recurrence; record measurements and test duration.
